policy.why: Keep the Git repository small; download from the Hub on the user's machine and record source metadata.
policy.quality_rule: Dataset license does not prove semantic correctness. Dataset previews were inspected, but full corpora were not manually audited row by row. AST parsing checks syntax only; downloaded code is never executed.
policy.mbpp_split: task IDs 601-974 training reference pool; 511-600 validation; 11-510 test; 1-10 reserved.

sources.quality: Template/NLP-derived instructions from CodeSearchNet; useful for coverage, not authoritative facts.
sources.use: Capped training source after deduplication and syntax filtering.

sources.quality: Crowdsourced tasks with reference solutions and tests; only a subset is hand-verified.
sources.use: Split by official task-id protocol; test rows never enter training.

arabic_policy.primary: Bilingual Python concept records in data/curated are checked against official Python documentation.
arabic_policy.external_general_arabic_corpora: Not mixed into Python factual training by default; general translation data cannot verify Python semantics.
arabic_policy.excluded: Non-commercial or unclear-license Arabic corpora are excluded from the default training pipeline.

excluded_sources.reason: The live dataset preview exposed malformed Python quoting/syntax in several visible rows and inconsistent row-count descriptions across card and viewer. Excluded from default training until a separate sample audit and repair policy exist.
